summary: Parses one UI surface definition block from a text stream. Reads 'location' and 'poswh' tokens as integer coordinate pairs via sub_565870/CRTFtol, reads the 'surface' name, and reads animation tokens ('animdelta' as float via sub_58850F, 'animrule' as int via sub_587ECE, 'subanimframe' as a recursive nested block). Once surface name and coordinates are present it creates the surface object through sub_499F70, then applies the parsed animation delta/rule to the created object. Tracks block nesting with a depth counter at this+0x194 (incremented on entry, decremented on exit).

local_names.this: UI element whose surface list is being built
local_names.a2: recursive parse context passed to nested subanimframe parse
local_names.a3: extra argument forwarded to surface object creation

operations.description: Initialize a 125-byte token buffer: seed byte 0 from global byte_5EA438[0], zero the remaining 0x7C bytes and the trailing 16-bit field.
Increment the UI block nesting depth counter this[101] (field +0x194), store the this pointer, and remember the new depth for the whole parse.
If sub_491FB0(this) (next input token reader) returns false, skip the parse loop entirely.
Iterate tokens with sub_491FB0(v14); each token is dispatched via sub_587C20 comparing against the shared compare buffer at unk_7CDB70.
Opening-block token asc_5CC4F4 matches: decrement depth v16; if it reaches zero break out of the parse loop.
Closing-block token asc_5CC4F8 matches: increment depth v16.
If sub_565870(aLocation, ...) parses the 'location' token into four floats, convert each float to int with CRTFtol (x/y/width/height) and mark coordinates as parsed.
Else if sub_565870(aPosWH, ...) parses the 'poswh' token, combine the two float pairs (v15+v13 and v17+v12) before CRTFtol conversion and mark coordinates as parsed.
Else if sub_5654A0(aSurface, v25) reads the 'surface' name token into v25, mark the surface-name flag.
Else if sub_5654A0(aAnimdelta, v22) reads the 'animdelta' token, parse it as a float with sub_58850F into v20.
Else if sub_5654A0(aAnimrule, v22) reads the 'animrule' token, parse it as an int with sub_587ECE into v21.
Else if sub_5654A0(aSubanimframe, v22) reads the 'subanimframe' token while a surface object already exists, recursively call sub_493990(a2, v18) to parse the nested frame block.
Once both the surface name and coordinates are present, create the surface object via sub_499F70(v4, v5, v3, v19, v25, 0, 1, a3) and mark the created flag.
After the parse loop, if a surface object exists, write the parsed animdelta float to created-object +24 when positive and the animrule int to created-object +28.
Decrement the nesting counter this[101] (field +0x194) and return 0.

clean_pseudocode: if sub_587C20(&unk_7CDB70, asc_5CC4F4): if --depth <= 0 break; continue
if sub_565870(aLocation, &v12,&v13,&v17,&v15,0,0,0,0): x=CRTFtol(v12); y=CRTFtol(v13); w=CRTFtol(v17); h=CRTFtol(v15)
elif sub_565870(aPosWH, &v12,&v13,&v17,&v15,0,0,0,0): w=CRTFtol(v13); h=CRTFtol(v15+v13); x=CRTFtol(v12); y=CRTFtol(v17+v12)
elif sub_5654A0(aSubanimframe, v22) and created: sub_493990(a2, obj)
if surface_seen and not created: obj = sub_499F70(x,y,w,h,v25,0,1,a3); created = 1
if obj: if animdelta > 0.0 obj+24 = animdelta; obj+28 = animrule
